messages:
Riley (devex): Heads-up: some onboarding repos started failing in edge runtimes after the npm publish. Error is `No matching export` when importing `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge`. Quick dump below.

Jon (eng-runtime): doh. That usually means the published package exports shape doesn't match what Workers/Vercel expect. Can you paste the exact import consumers use and the published package.json exports block?

Riley (devex): Consumers use `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk/edge'`. Pulled package.json from registry shows: "exports": { "./node": "./dist/node.cjs.js", "./edge": "./dist/edge.mjs", "./*": "./dist/*.js" } — this replaced an earlier wildcard-only layout. Types also stopped resolving in VSCode for the subpath.

Maya (eng-ml): Wildcard -> explicit subpath changes can break editor resolution and some strict ESM loaders. TS needs either `exports` map entries for `.d.ts` or `typesVersions` so `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` resolves to a declaration.

Jon (eng-runtime): Two quick mitigations: (A) add a root `edge.mjs` proxy file that re-exports `./dist/edge.mjs` so bundlers that ignore exports maps still find it, and (B) change `exports` to conditional objects with `import`/`require`/`default` to cover Node, bundlers, and older loaders. Also publish `dist/edge.d.ts` and add a types mapping.

Riley (devex): I'll draft a tiny PR with a) `edge.mjs` and `edge.cjs.js` proxy files, b) "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "require": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" } in exports, and c) a `typesVersions` mapping for the `edge` subpath. Also add a smoke test that `npm pack`s and imports the subpath in Node ESM and a wrangler-like script.

Jon (eng-runtime): Good. Long-term we should add an npm-pack + runtime-resolution step in release CI that runs a minimal import matrix: Node ESM, Bun, and a Cloudflare worker shim. We missed that on this release.

Release-bot: CI: sample-apps/edge-matrix failing on main with import-resolution errors related to sdk@0.4.0.

Maya (eng-ml): Also watch ordering of conditional keys. Some loaders match `default` before `import` depending on environment. Put `import`/`require` explicitly and include a fallback string for older consumers if needed.

Riley (devex): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1422 with the proxy files, exports change, types file, and a pack+resolve smoke test. Running CI.

Jon (eng-runtime): Once green, publish a canary and run our onboarding matrix (Next edge, Vercel, Wrangler). After that, add the release CI step and a short DX note in onboarding about subpath imports and how to prefer top-level imports when possible.

Riley (devex): Update: CI green, canary 0.4.1-canary published, verified Next+Wrangler edge samples locally. I'll follow up with a tiny postmortem and add the release CI job to the checklist. Monitoring logs for 48h. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :eyes: :shipit:)
